visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with black hair and glasses, wearing a light beige t-shirt and khaki shorts, stands on a body fat scale in a modern living room. A young girl in a yellow t-shirt sits on wooden steps behind him. The man holds the scale's handle out, looking nervous as he checks the digital display on the device. (2) In a bright indoor kitchen, the man presents a bag of konjac silk and two eggs to the camera. The girl assists in preparing the meal, using scissors to cut ingredients into a white bowl. They work over a black induction stovetop, stirring a mixture of shrimp and eggs in a frying pan. (3) The man and girl are shown together at a dining table. A large plate features several air-fried spring rolls and a cucumber salad. The man uses wooden chopsticks to dip one of the rolls into a small bowl of sauce while looking at the camera. The girl eats beside him. (4) The setting transitions back to a living room area at night. The man, now wearing a green Adidas t-shirt and black athletic shorts, performs a series of exercises including leg balances, push-ups, side planks, and kettlebell swings. His facial expressions show physical effort and sweat is visible.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A moderate-tempo male voice speaks Mandarin with a playful, expressive tone. The BGM features bright acoustic guitar and light piano chords. A digital 'ding' and a electronic beep signify the scale operation. (2) The acoustic environment shifts as kitchen sounds emerge: rhythmic chopping on a board, the high-frequency rustle of plastic packaging, and the metallic sound of chopsticks stirring in a pan. The girl's voice enters with a higher pitch and joyful inflection. (3) BGM continues as a steady backing track. Audible 'crunch' sounds are captured as the man bites into the air-fried rolls. His voice remains clear and descriptive, with occasional responses from the child. (4) The audio features a noticeable increase in the man's respiratory rate, with heavy, rhythmic exhales and grunts indicating physical exertion. The metallic clank of a kettlebell hitting the floor and muffled thuds of feet provide rhythmic percussion matching his movements. The upbeat BGM persists until the final animation.
